job_location: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
responsibilities: Define the Source of Truth: Take raw, complex data and transform it into clean, well-structured tables that Product Analysts and Business Leads can use for high-stakes decision-making. You know how to build a table that is intuitive and easy for other analysts to query.
Translate Strategy into Logic: Work with Product, Marketing, GTM analysts to turn abstract concepts into precise SQL definitions and automated datasets.
Maintain Data Integrity: Act as the guardian of our metrics. You will ensure that the numbers used across our product and business reports are consistent, reliable, and logical.
Enable High-Tech Initiatives: Partner with our AI and Data Service specialists to ensure they have the structured data foundations they need to build models and external data products.
Build Scalable Models: Design, build, and maintain production-grade data models using dbt, ensuring code is modular, tested, and documented.

Engineer with CI/CD Discipline: Treat analytics code like software. Work through pull requests, automated tests and deployments (GitHub/GitLab), code reviews, and version-controlled environments, so every change to the Source of Truth is tested before it ships.

Build with AI: Use AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code) in your daily workflow to speed up modeling, testing, documentation, and code review, and help the team define how we use them responsibly.
Make Data AI-Ready: Build well-documented models with clear definitions and a consistent metrics layer, so analysts, AI agents, and data products can rely on the same trusted data.
Take part in building Agentic solutions to support 24X7 solutions
